sn35.122:1.1: saññojaniye ca bhikkhave dhamme desissāmi saññojanañca
sn35.122:1.3: katame ca bhikkhave saññojaniyā dhammā katamañca saññojanaṃ.
sn35.122:1.4: santi bhikkhave cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā.
sn35.122:1.6: yo tattha chandarāgo taṃ tattha saññojanaṃ …pe…
sn35.122:1.8: santi bhikkhave manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā.
sn35.122:1.10: yo tattha chandarāgo taṃ tattha saññojananti.
